concerns.text: Tasks T002, T011, and T025 explicitly implement fallback logic to 8-bit/full precision or abort on deviation. This violates Constitution Principle VII ('Any deviation in the quantization scheme... invalidates the comparative analysis') and FR-002 which mandates strict 4-bit quantization. The task deliverable (a fallback mechanism) relaxes the constitutional constraint of deterministic generation.

Task T018 and T024 reference a 'max 1,000' cap, but the Plan.md 'Performance Goals' section explicitly targets '100 methods each' (2,000 total). The tasks do not resolve this contradiction; they inherit the Plan's drift. A task claiming to satisfy FR-001 (1,000 cap) while the Plan demands 100 creates a semantic weakening of the experimental scope defined in the Spec.

Task T010 ('Implement logic to load frozen data/raw/repo_list.json') is marked incomplete. The Spec (US-1) and Constitution (Principle I) require a frozen, verified dataset source. Without this task being complete, the foundational data layer required for US-1 is missing, violating the acceptance criterion that the system must process a 'representative set' from a verified source.

Task T001 ('Create project structure') is marked rejected/incomplete. The Spec and Plan define a specific directory structure (code/, data/raw/, data/processed/). Without this structure being established, the subsequent tasks (T015-T038) have no defined target paths, violating the 'Single Source of Truth' and 'Data Hygiene' principles regarding artifact placement.
